medidoPor: Lucía (dirección de arte), obra E12 del sitio v3 de SpindleLab
medidoCon: Chromium 141 headless (/opt/pw-browsers/chromium-1194) con Playwright 1.63, por el proxy del entorno; zona horaria America/Santiago, idioma es-CL
metodo: Cada página se carga hasta que llegan enteros el JS, el CSS y las tres letras (se reintenta si el proxy corta un archivo), se aceptan las cookies, se baja en pasos de 0,4 pantallas para disparar lo que aparece con el scroll y se vuelve arriba. Se lee getComputedStyle de cada nodo con texto visible, las hojas (document.styleSheets), las variables :root de Tailwind, document.getAnimations() en cada paso y un MutationObserver sobre lo que estaba oculto o corrido antes de entrar. 1440×900 a dpr 1; 390×844 a dpr 2 como teléfono (isMobile, sin hover). Las capturas son pantallas cosidas (capturar.mjs + coser.py).
limitaciones: Video: este Chromium no trae H.264 (canPlayType('video/mp4; avc1') = ''), así que ningún video de Koto se reproduce; se ven los pósteres. El showreel de la portada es un iframe de Vimeo (background=1, muted, loop) y queda negro.
El iframe de Vimeo se bloqueó en todas las corridas: al fallar movía el scroll de la página ~2 s después (medido: de 0 a 2205 px en el caso, sin ninguna llamada de Koto a scrollTo).
El encabezado fijo y las columnas pegajosas aparecen en cada pantalla de las capturas cosidas: así se ven al bajar.
A 390 la página se pide como teléfono (isMobile, hasTouch): Koto pone sus hovers dentro de @media (hover: hover), que ahí no aplica.
Las cajas de texto y de medios se suman por elemento: la densidad (densidad.textoPct, medioPct) es orden de magnitud; el área de color medida en serio está en pixeles.

areaEnPixeles.metodo:
Uso: python3 -I pixeles.py <dir-cuadros> <dir-crudo>   → <dir-crudo>/pixeles.json
Se cose otra vez cada página desde las pantallas PNG (sin pérdida, no los JPEG) y se clasifica cada
píxel contra los colores declarados en las variables de Koto (--color-*), con tolerancia, más el
amarillo por tono. Lo que no calza con ninguno es «imagen o video» (fotos, pósteres, ilustraciones).
Además se separa: dentro de las cajas de medios del DOM (img/video de medir.mjs) y fuera de ellas,
para saber cuánto pesa cada color en la interfaz sin contar las fotos.
Nota: el encabezado fijo aparece en cada pantalla cosida; su aporte es chico (≤ 48 px por pantalla).

movimiento.lecturaLibrerias: GSAP 3.13.0 (window.gsapVersions) con ScrollTrigger (y su Observer), SplitText, CustomEase y Draggable: cada uno deja su aviso «Please gsap.registerPlugin(…)» en los trozos de JS. ScrollSmoother e InertiaPlugin aparecen solo como menciones dentro del código de ScrollTrigger y de Draggable (no hay #smooth-wrapper y una vuelta de rueda de 100 px mueve la página en un cuadro). Cero coincidencias de Lenis, Framer Motion/Motion, Barba, Swup, Three, Locomotive, Lottie, startViewTransition y prefers-reduced-motion. Next.js (App Router, __next_f) con React y Tailwind v4 (variables --color-*, --text-*, --animate-* en :root).

lateral: From A to Я to あ
h: FROM A TO Я TO あ
conCifra: An 18-month project across 15 markets and more than 50 sub-brands.
One system, strong enough to carry across 50+ lines of business, flexible enough to stretch across global markets, audiences and teams.
We started with the first update to the Amazon logo in over 20 years.
Its bold, vibrant hue matches the energy we were infusing into the brand, dialing up the colors up to 11 while also making them more accessible.
The result is a singular typographic system that includes support for 364 languages including English, Japanese, Latin, Cyrillic, and many more.
The core Amazon brand had begun to look a little jaded after 24 years of parenting.
palabrasResultado: So now whether customers are shopping in the Amazon app, getting next-day delivery, watching award-winning content on Prime Video, streaming the latest hits on Amazon Music, or even receiving their prescription at Amazon Pharmacy, they are always met with a smile.
But as the company grew teams took on Ember as their own, despite it not being the best fit for their use cases.
It meets the needs of a global typeface that needs to be bold, playful, and loud in high-impact marketing moments as well as subtle and quiet in more functional moments of the digital experience.
The result?
The result is a singular typographic system that includes support for 364 languages including English, Japanese, Latin, Cyrillic, and many more.
Naturally, the Prime identity needed to match the Prime impact.

conCifra: Rakbank has been serving customers in the UAE for 50 years.
As their 50th anniversary approached, they wanted to cement their commitment to real service, and prove that you don’t have to choose between human and digital in banking.
We designed a cohesive suite of 11 different cards, using the brand architecture work to create a unified look for Personal, Elite, Islamic, Business, and Corporate banking.

h: A new job for an iconic wordmark

casos.titulo: The Norton Museum of Art | Koto
conCifra: The Norton Museum of Art has spent over 80 years quietly building something rare: a cultural institution where art and everyday life coexist.

The 40° angle in the 'N' becomes a through-line across the entire identity system, creating a brandmark that feels both established and decisively contemporary, and confident enough to sit at the very foreground of the brand.

Paul Manship's Diana — the sculpture Ralph Norton commissioned for the museum's founding in 1941 — had always captured something true about the Norton: fiercely independent, sharp-eyed and uncompromising in equal measure.
Adapted from the museum's 50th anniversary mark, she re-enters the identity as the institution's pioneering spirit, made visible.

h: Understanding a new audience for Adobe
conCifra: To deepen our collective read, we conducted a comprehensive two-day ethnographic analysis on the ground at the Adobe MAX conference, speaking directly, and in-depth with 10 MSCs.
Many established, agency-trained Adobe Creative Pros see the MSC path as a lucrative parallel economy alongside their 9-to-5.
Being an ambitious creator in 2026 means applying your talents beyond traditional client work.
In a world of niche algorithm pockets, a creator with 10 million followers can be entirely unknown to an adjacent group, while a micro-creator with 100k followers generates staggering income.
plata: In a world of niche algorithm pockets, a creator with 10 million followers can be entirely unknown to an adjacent group, while a micro-creator with 100k followers generates staggering income.

conCifra: Celebrating 50 years of Microsoft
In 2025, Microsoft turned 50 and asked us to create a campaign to mark the milestone.
From Clippy to Copilot, iconic 3D artefacts come together to form imaginative, immersive worlds.
Building a 3D universe

The campaign brought Change Needs Makers to life across every touchpoint – from a Microsoft.com takeover and product placements in Teams and Edge to a Times Square activation, limited-edition Microsoft merch, and a 50th-anniversary event at the Redmond campus.
The campaign marked a pivotal moment for Microsoft – a brief pause to reflect on 50 years of innovation before stepping confidently into its next era.
Shot on location across London using 16mm analogue film, the lead piece establishes an observed, tranquil tone—favoring natural pacing and lived-in performances over hyperbolic staging.

casos.titulo: Stack Overflow Rebrand: A legacy recoded | Koto
conCifra: By 2019 it was a tech institution with a growing suite of business products.
Then came 2022 and the boom of mainstream AI.
palabrasResultado: And we tied everything together with a new brand idea, Always in Build: a commitment to curiosity, growth and continuous evolution.
But as the category grew, so did the noise – with platforms blending into one another through similar claims, features and messaging.
Mews needed a brand that could clearly articulate its impact, and reflect the scale, ambition and difference of its product.
Our strategy centered on positioning Mews as the most impactful hospitality platform there is – one that doesn’t just support operations, but actively drives growth and elevates guest experiences.
This thinking was captured in the brand idea “Impact you can’t ignore” – a clear, confident expression of a platform delivering results you can see, measure and feel.
We built a flexible, scalable system designed to deliver impact at every level.
Elements scale dynamically depending on context, balancing clarity with impact at every touchpoint.

h: Life’s too short to waste on a bad meal
palabrasResultado: It sets a confident new direction for growth, participation, and deeper cultural relevance.

h: Known for gaming. Built for growth.
conCifra: The new B2B experience is structured around solutions and outcomes, with a key ‘Impact’ section demonstrating the ‘Growth Catalyst’ strategy in proving Coda's value to potential clients.
palabrasResultado: Built for growth.
We distilled this into a single-minded brand idea that captured their role in driving partner success: ‘Growth Catalyst,’ reframing their value from simple payments to essential growth partner.
The ‘Growth Catalyst’ idea inspired a confident identity system.
We used the 'C' from the logomark as a versatile graphic device, visually representing Coda as a central force for growth.
The new B2B experience is structured around solutions and outcomes, with a key ‘Impact’ section demonstrating the ‘Growth Catalyst’ strategy in proving Coda's value to potential clients.

conCifra: Founded by Netmarble in 2022, MARBLEX aimed to lead in blockchain gaming.
However, its initial focus on rapid technical development meant the brand got lost in complex Web3 mechanics—token exchanges, NFT trading, and the processes of the blockchain itself.
This mischievous figure – dubbed Goby – was an unexpected choice to lead a complex Web3 ecosystem, yet perfectly suited to cheekily embody the freedom, joy, and indulgence of gaming.

palabrasResultado: The result: a nutrition brand that swaps pressure for play, and supports you along the way.

conCifra: Since launching the brand, MachineX has powered over 236,000 trades from 9,858 unique addresses.
In October 2025 alone, trading volume exceeded $20M, bringing their total volume to more than $57M – and counting.

h: Every type of traveler, every type of trip
conCifra: For 25 years, Tripadvisor has been the world’s travel companion, with real reviews, real advice, straight from real people.
palabrasResultado: The result: a brand experience that feels modern, vibrant, and unmistakably Tripadvisor, wherever the journey begins.

conCifra: For over 150 years, Huntington has stood for Fair Play, putting financial power back in the hands of everyday people.
3D badges mark milestones, Huntington Serif adds rhythm and character, and motion brings warmth to every interaction.
palabrasResultado: But as the brand grew from a Midwest mainstay into a national player, the landscape had shifted.

conCifra: The world of B2B music creative services - like many others - is being disrupted and commoditized by AI.
The business is now equipped with an identity that can support louder and more expressive moments as well as the quieter more business-like one needed by B2B brands.
palabrasResultado: The visual identity centers on making the invisible impact of music visible.
By uniting individuals and nonprofits in one place, GoFundMe is helping move humankind forward with unprecedented impact and scale.

conCifra: But success brought fragmentation: countless sub-brands, record-breaking annual releases, and a wordmark unchanged since 2003.
palabrasResultado: Activision set out to unify the franchise under a single identity—one that could modernize its visual language, scale across new content, and sustain continued growth.

The refreshed wordmark replaced Impact, a decades-old typeface that had become meme-famous, while motion principles captured the franchise’s trademark intensity: rapid-fire thinking, sprinting towards objectives, and harsh recoil.
The result is the first truly unified Call of Duty® identity—consolidating two decades of fragmented growth into a single, scalable system.

h: For a new generation of listeners
conCifra: Founded in 2007, Deezer is a globally recognized music streaming service with a vast library and nearly 10 million paid subscribers.

Our strategy brought these qualities together in a single idea – from frontier to frontlines – a concept that bridges pioneering spirit with on-the-ground impact.
The identity balances personality and depth to support business growth, creating a consistent yet distinctive brand experience.

conCifra: Bolt’s answer is a checkout that moves at the speed of a click: 50 milliseconds.

h: From IRL to URL and back again
palabrasResultado: The result is an identity that feels bold and enterprise-grade, but still crafted and human.

conCifra: Serving more than 2 billion people globally, WhatsApp needed to evolve beyond the perception of being “just another social media app.” As the world’s most trusted communication platform, it required a universal design system that could bridge product and marketing—deepening the connection between its secure, intimate product experience and its outward marketing communications, while staying true to the promise of safe, accessible communication for anyone, anywhere.

palabrasResultado: The result is a brand that honors WhatsApp’s intimate, secure nature while connecting authentically with billions of users around the world.

conCifra: The campaign launched with a 15-second commercial that brought CFG’s world to life, supported by animated GIFs and banner ads featuring the giant’s hands and “cryptoes” as central characters.
With over 30 billion devices expected online by 2030, true connectivity remains fragmented.
plata: With over 30 billion devices expected online by 2030, true connectivity remains fragmented.
palabrasResultado: The brand strategy draws inspiration from the dandelion, symbolising effortless connectivity and exponential growth – seeds carried anywhere, creating infinite new possibilities across networks and ecosystems.
Radiating patterns, fluid forms, and bold colour transitions express the idea of constant motion, growth, and connection, giving the identity both energy and adaptability across every touchpoint.
